elements.justification: "a vehicle": the left-turning road user t, other than ego, of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ("every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway"); "The driver" read through its controlled motion.

"within an intersection": t's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) the intersection i (st.intersection); i is the region t's intention is declared at and the one it entered from its approach carrier c_t.

"having given a signal": t showed a left signal, its turn indicator state left (sig.turn_indicator, 'the turn indicator state ... left') or an arm signal of meaning left (sig.hand_signal), at some observation since its latest stretch on its approach carrier c_t into i began; the signal itself, not a declared intention, and not the turn. "when and as required": the timing and manner another statute sets, outside this corpus; the signal is read as given at or before the judged observation.

"may make such left turn": t is making the left turn it intends, drv.motion.turning_left (moving with its heading turning to the left at or above the yaw tolerance), a turn under way rather than one completed. The turn under way is one continuous stretch: drv.motion.turning_left has held for t at every observation since the observation at which it last rose (the turn's observed onset), and that onset is the moment at which "having so yielded" (f10) is read.

"the drivers of all other vehicles": ego, a vehicle (admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) other than t, its driver read through its controlled motion. "approaching the intersection": ego occupies (rel.occupies) a carrier c_e (st.travel_region) whose entrance end is i (st.lane_enters), the ontology's reading of a road user's approach to an intersection, whatever its motion. "from the opposite direction": c_e and the carrier c_t from which t entered i carry opposed designated directions (st.lane_direction), as rel.oncoming's contract directs, not the current headings, which t's turn changes.
"shall yield": granting precedence (DEF-NRS-484A-210 "unless one grants precedence to the other"): ego is at rest (drv.motion.at_rest) or not in conflict with t (operationalization of f15).
"the vehicle making the left turn": the same t, turning left (drv.motion.turning_left) at the judged observation, within the continuous turning stretch of f12.

operationalizations.standard: the right-of-way: DEF-NRS-484A-210 "approaching under such circumstances of direction, speed and proximity as to give rise to the danger of a crash unless one grants precedence to the other"
operationalizations.convention: Traffic-conflict technique: two road users are in conflict where, projected at their current velocities, their centres approach within the time-to-collision horizon and their closest-approach centre distance is below the clearance at which their bodies would touch. Direction, speed and proximity enter by degree through the projected velocities and positions.

applicability: Ego is a vehicle (driven: agency reading) occupying a carrier c_e (st.travel_region, rel.occupies) whose entrance end is an intersection i (st.lane_enters), and some vehicle t other than ego (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) at the judged observation: overlaps i (rel.occupies); declares int.left_turn at i; is turning left (drv.motion.turning_left, p.turn_yaw_tolerance, p.rest_speed_tolerance) and has been turning left at every observation since the observation at which drv.motion.turning_left last rose for it (the onset of the turn under way); has, at that onset, "so yielded": there is an earlier or equal observation at which t occupied a carrier c_t (st.travel_region, rel.occupies) whose entrance end is i (st.lane_enters) while not overlapping i, and at every observation after it up to and including the onset t overlapped i and complied with NRS_484B_253_o1 (t as its ego) — compliance read only up to the onset, since "having so yielded" is past to the turn, and NOT at the observations of the turn after it; showed a left signal (sig.turn_indicator left or sig.hand_signal left) at some observation since its latest stretch on c_t began (no rise of its occupancy of c_t after the signal); and c_t's and c_e's designated directions (st.lane_direction) have a dot product below minus p.opposite_direction_tolerance.
obligation: Ego is at rest (drv.motion.at_rest, p.rest_speed_tolerance), or for every intersection i, carrier c_e and vehicle t selected exactly as in the applicability (the whole selection re-bound: ego on c_e entering i; t other than ego, a vehicle, overlapping i, declaring int.left_turn at i, turning left continuously since the turn's onset, having entered i from an opposed carrier c_t and complied with NRS_484B_253_o1 from that entry up to and including the onset, and having signalled left since its latest stretch on c_t began), ego is not in conflict with t: not both prim.closest_approach_within(ego, t) with horizon p.conflict_horizon and prim.closest_approach_distance(ego, t) with the same horizon below p.conflict_clearance.

narrowings.why: 'the drivers' are read through the vehicles' controlled motion.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Vehicle t entered the intersection from its approach lane with int.left_turn and its left indicator on since its approach, waited at rest while ego, approaching from the opposite direction, was far off, and began its left turn at an observation at which its projected closest approach with ego did not lie within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_clearance (so t complied with NRS_484B_253_o1 up to its onset). t turns slowly; ego keeps moving without slowing, and at a later observation of the same turn their projected closest approach lies within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_clearance.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same scene as forbid; ego slows and comes to rest at the edge of the intersection, and is at rest at every observation at which its projected closest approach with the turning t would lie within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_clearance, until t completes its turn.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: t crosses the intersection straight ahead (int.left_turn false, not turning left); ego approaches from the opposite direction.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Scene of forbid, but the source declares sig.turn_indicator and sig.hand_signal absent: whether t signalled cannot be read.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but t's indicator stayed off and it gave no arm signal: t gave no signal, so the opposing drivers' duty does not arise.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but t began its turn at an observation at which ego, approaching from the opposite direction, was within the immediate-hazard distance of the intersection and their projected closest approach lay within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_clearance: t did not yield as NRS_484B_253_o1 requires up to its onset, so the duty to yield to it does not arise.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but t's indicator stays off and it gives a left arm signal (sig.hand_signal left) since its approach: the signal is given, and ego, in conflict with the turning t, has not yielded.

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: Ego approaches the intersection alone on its approach lane; no other road user is in the scene.
